tasks.title: Replace modality shortcuts in the public ML guide

acceptance.description: Replace modality shortcuts in the public ML guide with a reproducible observable result
acceptance.evidence_oracle: K1 holds input modality constant while the preferred policy changes with workload or missed-case cost. Old absolute numerical speed/cost claims either gain scoped measurements or are removed. A text label task can choose a conventional classifier. The documented commands generate the model and independently score the unseen examples. The measured results are kept separate from K1’s hand-calculated policy table. The K1 regression fixture rejects a mislabeled scorer and distinguishes MSE of 1/3 from R-squared of 7/8.

evidence.command: Run the receipt train and score commands, then python -B -m unittest discover -s skills/languages/python-ml-predictive/examples/ticket-triage -p "test_*.py" -v

tasks.title: Test corpus preparation, retrieval and answer quality independently

acceptance.description: Test corpus preparation, retrieval and answer quality independently with a reproducible observable result
acceptance.evidence_oracle: K2 permits a correct ranking with a failed answer-support grade. With no eligible document the system abstains. Original identifiers survive normalization and retrieval output contains no inaccessible or withdrawn row. The evaluator can identify a wrong result introduced by removing a meaningful token, recover its unmodified source and rerun the comparison.

evidence.command: Run the E02 receipt commands, compare normal and --drop-negation outputs to result.json and negative-control.json, and run the four curated-retrieval unit tests.

tasks.title: Select adaptation or media generation against a fixed comparator

acceptance.description: Select adaptation or media generation against a fixed comparator with a reproducible observable result
acceptance.evidence_oracle: K4 rejects a candidate adapter on the wrong base. K5 detects duplicated outputs and missing rights. The guide reports which quality measures still require a real model and reviewers. No GPU, training or provider performance is claimed from metadata. A missing model or license produces a complete decision record with the unrun inference or training step visibly unresolved.

evidence.command: Run the two offline adaptation-review commands and four focused unit tests documented in receipt.md.

tasks.title: Diagnose data, model and serving failures with recoverable releases

acceptance.description: Diagnose data, model and serving failures with recoverable releases with a reproducible observable result
acceptance.evidence_oracle: K4 distinguishes all three failure classes, restores the compatible bundle and prevents duplicate effects on retry. An alert with missing labels states what is observable and defers any accuracy claim.

tasks.title: Use repository-aware coding assistance and independent review

acceptance.description: Use repository-aware coding assistance and independent review with a reproducible observable result
acceptance.evidence_oracle: K3 fails the original defect, rejects a plausible incorrect implementation, and passes a correct one through a normal caller. Include pre-change persisted data and evidence from independent execution. Scope, fallback and rework stay in the receipt.

tasks.title: Prove the public routes and catalog still work

acceptance.description: Prove the public routes and catalog still work with a reproducible observable result
acceptance.evidence_oracle: A user seeking predictive text classification reaches the intended public route; ground an answer, recover an incident and review an AI-authored patch each reach an appropriate owner. Show before/after routing on the same fixtures and retain unrelated baseline warnings.
